article.title: 蘋果招募由NotebookLM前員工合組的AI podcast App公司Huxe
article.summary:
近日一份公告文件顯示，蘋果於今年春天招募了Google NotebookLM前團隊成員創立的AI podcast App業者Huxe核心成員並取得技術授權。
根據歐盟列出大廠申報的收購清單，蘋果在今年6月向Huxe AI提出員工招募提案，招募了特定員工，並獲得後者智財權的非獨家技術授權。
蘋果描述Huxe開發的是建造個人化音訊內容的手機應用程式。

article.title: Deals: Big discounts hit flagship phones from Samsung, Apple and Google
article.summary: While Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days have wrapped up, discounts are still available on several smartphones. In fact, some devices that received few or no notable discounts during the sale are now available at reduced prices. Samsung’s Galaxy S26 Ultra, Apple’s iPhone 17 Pro lineup, and the entire Google Pixel 11 series are among the phones on sale this weekend. The latest Samsung Galaxy Z foldables have also been discounted. The Galaxy S26 Ultra and the Galaxy S26+ are both available with good discounts.
